chunks: And whatever was in it from Dawud ibn Abi Yazid, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from al-ʿAbbas ibn Maʿruf, from Abu Muhammad al-Hajjal, from Dawud ibn Abi Yazid.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the immediate transmitter in the author’s sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْحَجَّالِ: al-Hajjal; an identifying epithet within the narrator chain
key_terms.دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ: Dawud ibn Abi Yazid; the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating the author’s mode of narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Dawud ibn Abi Yazid in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Dawud ibn Abi Yazid. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission in hadith literature and clarifying the author’s source path for these reports.
